review.scope: Programme with corrected time column, earlier captured presentation library/detail wrapper and generic inline projection/presenter engine.
review.method: Source extraction by this documenter, with manual browser evidence supplied by the root agent. The documenter ran no shell command, browser, server, build or test.
suppliedEvidence: All ten wide-table time cells measured 112px without clipping at viewport widths 1440 and 1024.
No horizontal overflow reported at viewport widths 390, 768, 1024 and 1440.
Native fullscreen worked in the main viewer and programme.

Two-way audience/presenter popup synchronization worked with the former inline demo before its authorized removal; it is evidence for the generic engine, not for the currently registered standalone deck.
review.limitation: The SHIP verdict applies only to the stated reviewed scope. Native fullscreen in the separate generic audience popup was denied in the IAB/focus context; support in every browser is not established. Earlier main-viewer fullscreen evidence predates the new iframe-targeted fullscreen control.
review.assets: Shipping media includes the existing Eneo SVG wordmark, SVG presentation cover, supplied programme PDF, authored standalone HTML file and four generated JPEG integration illustrations. The raster provenance and exact prompts are in .impeccable/assets/integrations.json and embedded in the JPEGs. Review captures are evidence, not shipping assets.
review.sourceOnlyScope: External deck content, newer manuscript/iframe-fullscreen controls and illustrated integration surfaces are described from latest source; they were not independently reviewed in this pass.

components.name: Generic Audience SlideCanvas
components.description: The retained generic inline engine uses a full-width pale-blue audience canvas with scalable normal-weight body text. This snippet is structural; no inline example deck is registered.

narrative.overview:
The supplied invitation establishes the blue and white palette and plain sans serif character. Astryx's documentation template supplies the navigation and reading frame. The existing Eneo SVG wordmark anchors the shell, programme and presentation tools; preserve its proportions and artwork.

Extend this same visual identity across reading, material selection and projection. Timetable rows stay dense and ordered, presentation covers make the library easy to scan, and the audience canvas gives the slide more space and larger type. The standalone HTML presentation retains its own authored design inside its file.
keyCharacteristics: Blue actions, dark blue text, white surfaces and pale blue reading panels.
A familiar documentation shell with readable text widths and wrapping actions.
Invitation-style programme rows with a persistent time column and distinct track fields.
Image-led presentation cards and a restrained, scalable audience canvas.
Astryx-owned focus, interaction and mobile navigation states.

rules.name: The Theme Owner Rule
rules.body: Keep the meeting, projection and programme palettes in `src/astryx-themes.ts`; extend their semantic tokens instead of adding page-level palette overrides.

rules.name: The Time Rail Rule
rules.body: Preserve the dedicated time width and equal track columns; switch to labelled stacked rows when the programme's own content area is too narrow.

dos: Do reuse Astryx components, the documentation frame and the existing Eneo wordmark.
Do keep palette decisions in the theme and programme/presentation content in the typed registry.
Do preserve readable widths, wrapping tools and the programme's measured time-rail layout.
Do keep notes in their format's owner and render them only in its presenter view.
Do distinguish preparation material from the invitation's programme facts.
donts: Don't replace dense programme or resource rows with card-wrapped lists.
Don't apply generic inline-slide styling or controls to the standalone HTML file's internals.
Don't bypass Astryx's focus, mobile navigation or reduced-motion behavior.
Don't introduce a second palette, spacing scale or altered wordmark.
